maya: quick design check — we switched the models grid to a "snap" keyboard flow (tab/shift-tab jumps to closest column). worried about screen reader verbosity + focus ring jitter when the visual layout reflows. thoughts? :eyes: jordan: can you paste the markup? is each card a button or link? maya: each card is a button (click opens details). current DOM is row-major (left-to-right, top-to-bottom). visual layout uses CSS grid with responsive columns. no separate hidden focusable elements. eli: quick thoughts: role=grid + role=row + role=gridcell is fine for a 2D nav, but if Tab is moving across columns we need to be explicit about Arrow key behaviour. screen readers expect arrow keys to move within grid; Tab should move out of the grid. If you're using Tab to snap across columns you can confuse SR users. dena: from our usability sessions — keyboard-only folks expect either strict linear tabbing OR a consistent 2D arrow nav. mixing both leads to people losing context. recommendation: keep Tab => move out/into the whole grid, and support arrow keys for intra-grid movement. jordan: ok, that means implement roving tabindex for arrow keys and keep Tab as entry/exit. I can prototype. to avoid announcement spam, debounce aria-live updates. eli: suggested SR announcement text when focus lands on a card: "Model: , card of , status ". include aria-posinset and aria-setsize on gridcell so some AT will announce position automatically. also add aria-label for the status icon. jordan: sample snippet I'm going to try: ```
``` maya: also — the focus ring seems to jump because we change CSS transforms for layout. idea: keep element in-flow, apply a subtle box-shadow outline rather than reflowing transform on focus. that reduced perceived jump in the prototype. eli: agree. for contrast: current focus outline fails 3:1 on dark theme per the a11y audit. use at least 4.5:1 for interactive focus. a11y-bot: automated scan: "focus-outline-dark-theme.png" flagged; rule: focus contrast < 4.5. Created issue #A11Y-482. jordan: thanks — I'll update the CSS tokens and implement roving tabindex + arrow key handlers. i'll post a quick demo later today. maya: one last nit on copy — when announcing via aria-live, avoid verbose timestamps. keep it to name + index + status. less is better for SR users. dena: agree. also add a tooltip for hover with keyboard hint: "Arrow keys to move, Enter to open" — helps discoverability. jordan: noted. I'll prototype and ping this thread when demo is up. :thumbsup:
_meta: This Slack thread is a design/a11y review about grid keyboard navigation, focus ring, aria roles, and screen reader announcements. Messages are presented in chronological order and follow Slack-style brevity.
